rules: Sort by size: big ones in the left bowl, small ones in the right bowl.
demo: Move both big blocks into the left bowl and both small blocks into the right bowl.

rules: Sort by color, one bowl per color.
demo: Red blocks into the left bowl, the blue block into the middle bowl, the green block into the right bowl.

rules: Sort by size, and don't touch the glass.
demo: Big blocks into the left bowl, small blocks into the right bowl; carry them around the tall glass without touching it.

rules: Clear everything into the middle bowl, but leave the glass alone.
demo: Every block and the yellow cylinder go into the middle bowl; the glass stays where it is.

rules: Cylinders in the left bowl, cubes in the right bowl.
demo: Both yellow cylinders into the left bowl, both blocks into the right bowl.

rules: Sort by color, but blue things stay where they are.
demo: The red block into the left bowl, the green block into the right bowl; both blue blocks stay put.
